## Checklist

- [ ] Change is scoped and matches the description, with no unrelated edits
- [ ] Any behavior checks used disposable data; no live app, profile, or workspace was mutated
- [ ] No credentials, tokens, or sensitive log content added or exposed
- [ ] Docs updated where behavior or setup changed
- [ ] Relevant checks listed accurately, including checks not run
- [ ] No generated artifacts or build output committed

Documentation-only changes need correct links, paths, and whitespace. Full
`pnpm test` and `pnpm typecheck` are not required for them.
